choose.when: SELECT ro.source_type, ro.id order_id, COALESCE(xo.external_order_id,ro.order_no) order_no, NULL device_id, NULL assignment_id, NULL device_no, NULL equipment_model_code, ro.occupy_start_date due_date FROM rental_order ro LEFT JOIN xianyu_order xo ON xo.id=ro.channel_order_id AND xo.tenant_id=ro.tenant_id AND xo.deleted=0 WHERE ro.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ro.deleted=0 AND ro.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED') AND ro.occupy_start_date <= #{today} AND (xo.id IS NULL OR (xo.order_status='12' AND xo.consign_time IS NULL AND xo.cancel_time IS NULL)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_order_item i WHERE i.rental_order_id=ro.id AND i.tenant_id=ro.tenant_id AND i.deleted=0 AND i.quantity > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental_device_assignment a WHERE a.rental_order_item_id=i.id AND a.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND a.deleted=0 AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN','RETURNED')))
choose.otherwise:
SELECT ro.source_type, a.rental_order_id order_id, ro.order_no, d.id device_id, a.id assignment_id, d.device_no, d.equipment_model_code, DATE_SUB(ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive, INTERVAL 1 DAY) due_date FROM rental_device_assignment a JOIN rental_device d ON d.id=a.device_id AND d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.deleted=0 JOIN rental_order ro ON ro.id=a.rental_order_id AND ro.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ro.deleted=0 WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=0
AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN') AND a.returned_at IS NOT NULL AND a.inspection_completed_at IS NULL
AND d.status='MAINTENANCE' AND a.status='RETURNED' AND a.inspection_result='FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_device_assignment newer WHERE newer.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND newer.device_id=a.device_id AND newer.deleted=0 AND newer.id>a.id AND newer.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN','RETURNED'))
AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN') AND a.returned_at IS NULL
AND ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive=DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive <= #{today}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () t ORDER BY due_date ASC, order_id ASC, device_id ASC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
